findings.title: Rimba Terrace hero image fails to load (HTTP 500 asset)
findings.severity_rationale: Primary visual content on a property detail page is broken but core booking controls remain usable.
findings.priority_rationale: Customer-facing quality issue that should be fixed soon, but not a full booking blocker.
findings.impact: Users see a broken image icon on the stay detail page, reducing trust and merchandising quality.
preconditions: Signed in as guest user (also reproducible while signed out).
steps: Open Discover listing and navigate to Rimba Terrace detail page.
Observe the hero illustration area above the property heading.
Inspect network requests for image assets.
findings.expected: The Rimba Terrace illustration should render like other properties.
findings.expected_basis: Other stay pages load valid SVG assets; media is a core part of property presentation.
findings.actual: The illustration is broken, and GET /assets/missing-rimba.svg returns HTTP 500.
findings.comparison: Other property illustrations such as /assets/coast.svg and /assets/garden.svg return HTTP 200 and render.
possible_causes: Asset path points to a missing file or backend static-asset mapping for missing-rimba.svg is broken.
findings.recommendation: Replace/fix the missing-rimba asset reference and add an automated asset integrity check for hotel media links.

findings.title: Footer Booking policies link routes to 404 Not found
findings.severity_rationale: A legal/policy navigation entry in global footer is unreachable, affecting compliance and user trust.
findings.priority_rationale: Global footer defect with broad impact and potential policy disclosure risk.
findings.impact: Users cannot access booking policy content from the advertised footer link.
preconditions: Any page where footer is visible.
steps: Open a content page (example: Rimba Terrace hotel detail).
Observe destination page content and network status.
findings.expected: Link should open a valid booking policy page with policy content.
findings.expected_basis: Footer information architecture explicitly advertises booking policy access.
findings.actual: Destination displays only "Not found" and document request returns HTTP 404.
findings.comparison: Main app routes (e.g., /#/hotel/rimba-terrace) resolve correctly, indicating this path is specifically broken.
possible_causes: Route not implemented or static server missing this document endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Implement/restore the booking policies route or update footer href to the correct canonical policy URL.

inventory: Global header with auth-aware account actions (Discover, Saved stays, My bookings, My account).
Discovery list with filters (All stays/With a pool) and sort control.
Hotel detail page with pricing panel, promotion input, and reservation CTA.
Global footer containing Booking policies link.

evidence.caption: Rimba Terrace page shows broken image placeholder where hero illustration should render.
Network evidence of missing-rimba asset request failing with HTTP 500.
Booking policies navigation lands on plain Not found page.

observations: Login baseline succeeded with provided guest account and session persisted in header state.
limitations: Assessment intentionally stopped after two confirmed defects per focused sampled-run stopping rule.
End-to-end reservation completion, cancellation lifecycle, accessibility audit, and performance profiling were not executed in this run.

Fix Rimba Terrace media asset mapping and recheck image loading on listing and detail pages.
